note:
One XIAO ESP32S3 Sense order (quantity one) and USD 13.67 payment were reconciled on 2026-11-22; carrier delivery was reported for 2026-11-07. Actual bench count, board markings, condition and hardware revision remain uninspected and unverified. WROOM, bank and OLED counts remain unknown; MG90S count is now estimated by the user at about 10, not confirmed. Power bank is unidentified and user reports no readable rating label; do not infer 2 A/3 A or usable whole-robot power. All five use the same full core with removable cosmetics. Latest quoted plan is not new inventory evidence. Touch and motion sensing are required. The owned AT42QT1010 is the prototype touch choice. RGB and haptics are optional. Matched1S kit replaces required bank purchase. Photo audit now establishes at least one BerryIMU and nine other module types; paired photos are not extra units. MPU6050 remains the selected first-unit IMU; the unqualified BerryIMU is a separate photographed spare and cannot fill the MPU6050 slot; optional spares do not replace required floor sensing, speaker output or power parts.
